tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a header/metadata field not represented as a leaf element in the MeF schema for Schedule B.

taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a form header field inherited from the parent 1040 return and not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule B schema.

ssn.rationale: Primary filer SSN is a form header field inherited from the parent 1040 return and not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule B schema.

interest_payers.rationale: Form1040SchBPartIGroup2 is the repeating group for non-seller-financed interest payer rows (name + amount) in Part I; blueprint 'interest_payers' maps to this group, though the canonical schema splits it into BusinessNameLine1Txt/BusinessNameLine2Txt and InterestAmt child elements.

total_taxable_interest.rationale: CalculatedTotalTaxableIntAmt directly represents the net total taxable interest computed for Part I, corresponding to Form 1040 line 2b.

excludable_us_savings_bond_interest.rationale: ExcludableSavingsBondIntAmt directly represents the Part I line for interest on U.S. savings bonds excluded via Form 8815.

seller_financed_mortgage_interest.rationale: Form1040SchBPartIGroup1 is the repeating group for seller-financed mortgage interest entries (name, SSN, address, amount); blueprint 'seller_financed_mortgage_interest' maps to this group, though the canonical schema splits it into multiple child elements.

dividend_payers.rationale: Form1040SchBPartII is the repeating group for ordinary dividend payer rows (name + amount) in Part II; blueprint 'dividend_payers' maps to this group, though the canonical schema splits it into BusinessNameLine1Txt/BusinessNameLine2Txt and DividendAmt child elements.

total_ordinary_dividends.rationale: TotalOrdinaryDividendsAmt directly represents the Part II total ordinary dividends line, corresponding to Form 1040 line 3b.

had_foreign_account.rationale: ForeignAccountsQuestionInd directly represents the Part III line 7a yes/no indicator for having a financial interest in or signature authority over a foreign financial account.

foreign_country_name.rationale: ForeignCountryCd represents the Part III line 7b field where the taxpayer names the foreign country if line 7a is Yes.

fbar_required.rationale: FinCENForm114Ind directly represents the indicator for whether the taxpayer is required to file FinCEN Form 114 (FBAR).

received_distribution_from_foreign_trust.rationale: ForeignTrustQuestionInd directly represents the Part III line 8 yes/no indicator for receiving a distribution from or being a grantor/transferor to a foreign trust.

form_3520_required.rationale: No candidate element exists in the Schedule B MeF schema for the Form 3520 follow-up question; this sub-question is not captured as a separate leaf element in the canonical schema.
